programme: P27–P35 Local 54-Indicator Completion and Provenance Programme
authority: Scheduling/execution overlay only. data/local-54-completion-roadmap.json controls phase meaning and acceptance.
work_rules: Use indicator-wide pipelines before geography-by-geography manual work.
Use one governed source/evidence family per tranche where practical.
Every tranche must update the candidate/provenance layer before preferred observations.
Do not weaken anti-inheritance, boundary-vintage, uncertainty or release gates for throughput.
Secondary evidence may be used only under the source-tier policy and must retain fallback reason plus lineage.
Conflicting evidence must be preserved; preferred-value publication must follow the conflict policy.
Prefer truthful labelled representation to omission whenever a defensible value exists.
Apply the same source-tier and representation rules retrospectively to existing KDA data through P28A.
Generated outputs must be deterministic and validation-ready before merge.

execution_tracks.name: Contract, provenance, legacy audit and denominator
execution_tracks.exit: Exact 54-indicator contract, source policy, completed legacy provenance/omission audit and 93,960-cell child ledger exist.

execution_tracks.name: Representation
execution_tracks.exit: 47/47 county Woman Representative dispositions and extensible representative schema exist.

execution_tracks.name: Constituency completion
execution_tracks.batching: Prefer indicator-wide national tranches. Manual exceptions only after pipeline/crosswalk failure is recorded. Use labelled secondary/probable/modelled values rather than omission where defensible.

execution_tracks.name: Ward completion
execution_tracks.batching: Prefer direct ward records, exact aggregation and approved geospatial pipelines before secondary/modelled fallback. Use labelled fallback rather than omission where defensible.

execution_tracks.name: Conflict adjudication
execution_tracks.exit: No preferred conflicting value lacks candidates, rationale or confidence.

execution_tracks.name: Public product and permanent gate
execution_tracks.exit: All 54 visible everywhere applicable; release-blocking local completeness/freshness gate and recurring legacy provenance re-audit are active.

recommended_tranche_order: P27.1 inventory current local indicators and reconcile 49→54 target
P28.1 implement S0–S7 source tiers and labels
P28.2 implement evidence-lineage and conflict schemas
P28A.1 inventory all in-scope existing preferred observations and source metadata
P28A.2 classify existing observations to S0–S7 and remediate unlabelled secondary provenance
P28A.3 re-open existing unavailable/omitted states and search for credible labelled representation opportunities
P28A.4 reconstruct and adjudicate material legacy conflicts; publish audit summary
P29.1 generate county audit + constituency ledger
P31.x complete constituencies by indicator family, highest-authority/easiest first
P32.x complete wards by indicator family, direct/exact/spatial before fallback
P33.x adjudicate conflicts continuously and clear final manual-review queue
P34.1 render 54-indicator skeleton and provenance UI
P34.2 render representation and conflict states; run browser/accessibility tests
P35.1 wire release validator and refresh/supersession queues
P35.2 wire recurring legacy unavailable/secondary re-audit
P35.3 final deterministic rebuild and release audit

legacy_audit_execution.scope_rule: Audit existing KDA observations and omission/closure states before relying on the new source policy only for new data.
legacy_audit_execution.priority: First fix mislabelled/unknown provenance, then promote clearly representable legacy omissions, then adjudicate legacy conflicts.
legacy_audit_execution.completion_rule: P28 cannot close until P28A acceptance is satisfied.

per_tranche_checklist: Confirm target indicator IDs and geography scope.
Acquire and snapshot primary evidence where possible.
If fallback is needed, classify secondary evidence tier and evidence lineage.
Normalize period, unit, boundary vintage and indicator definition.
Write all defensible candidate observations before preferred selection.
Apply conflict policy where candidates disagree.
Prefer a labelled defensible value over an unavailable state when publication would not be misleading.
Materialise preferred observations or governed closure state.
Run focused validator, full Atlas validation and release/browser gates when public runtime changes.
Update roadmap progress only after deterministic outputs are committed.

merge_strategy.preferred: Small auditable PRs by contract/source family/indicator family; allow consolidated PRs only when generated outputs are deterministic and reviewable.
